configuration.sonar_projectKey.descripti: SonarQube project. Managed from SonarQube Dashboard & Pipeline.
configuration.sonar_projectName.descript: Name of the selected SonarQube project. Managed from SonarQube Dashboard & Pipeline.
configuration.sonar_branch.description: SonarQube branch. Managed from SonarQube Dashboard & Pipeline.

configuration.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh issues when the workspace is opened or changed.
configuration.modules.pipeline.enabled.d: Enable the Pipeline module. When disabled, pipeline analysis, history, the sidebar view, and its configuration tab are unavailable.
configuration.modules.liveRemediation.en: Enable the Live Remediation module. When disabled, local issue tracking, its sidebar view, status bar state, and its configuration tab are unavailable.
configuration.liveRemediation.enabled.de: Track local edits to synchronized SonarQube issues. SonarQube for IDE is optional: when active, its independent diagnostics help distinguish changes pending validation from changes awaiting server confirmation, without declaring an issue fixed before SonarQube analysis.
configuration.sonar_scannerMode.descript: Method used by the Analyze repository button.
configuration.scannerMode.auto: Detects Maven, Gradle, and .NET; uses NPM with package.json or Docker for generic projects.
configuration.scannerMode.npm: Uses SonarScanner for NPM as a generic scanner.
configuration.sonar_analysisInclusions.d: Optional sonar.inclusions patterns for repository analysis. Use one pattern per line or separate patterns with commas.
configuration.sonar_analysisExclusions.d: Optional sonar.exclusions patterns for repository analysis. Use one pattern per line or separate patterns with commas.
configuration.sonar_buildCommand.descrip: Optional build command run before the generic scanner or instead of dotnet build.
configuration.sonar_customScannerCommand: Custom analysis command. The token is provided through SONAR_TOKEN.
Pipeline commands run before the SonarQube analysis. Use one command per line and optionally prefix it with Name ::.
configuration.sonar_postAnalysisCommands: Pipeline commands run after SonarQube successfully processes the analysis. Use one command per line and optionally prefix it with Name ::.
capabilities.untrusted.description: The dashboard can query SonarQube, but repository analysis requires a trusted workspace.

walkthrough.title: Get started with SonarQube Dashboard & Pipeline
walkthrough.description: Connect a SonarQube project, synchronize its quality data, run a local analysis pipeline, and inspect the results without leaving VS Code.
walkthrough.open.title: Open the dashboard
walkthrough.open.description: Open the [SonarQube Dashboard & Pipeline](command:sonarQubeDashboard.open) and use the side panel as the entry point for data, configuration, diagnostics, pipeline executions, and issues.
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect your SonarQube project
walkthrough.connect.description: Open [Configuration](command:sonarQubeDashboard.configure), enter the SonarQube server URL and access token, select the project that matches the workspace, and synchronize it.
walkthrough.analyze.title: Run your first quality pipeline
walkthrough.analyze.description: Run [Analyze repository](command:sonarQubeDashboard.analyze), review the selected steps, and confirm the pipeline. Scanner output and step status are streamed into the execution view.
walkthrough.analyze.alt: Quality pipeline execution with step status and console output
walkthrough.results.title: Inspect quality results
walkthrough.results.description: Use the dashboard, Problems, Issue explorer, Security Hotspots, coverage, duplication, and execution history to review the synchronized results. Open a finding to navigate directly to its source file.
walkthrough.results.alt: Dashboard with Quality Gate, ratings, issues, and project metrics
